description: Worst-case price of a job (its whole timeout) and whether it is allowed. Jobs from outside are free while the network is in its first phase.

command.description: argv, e.g. ["python3", "sim.py"]; never a shell string

files.description: relative path -> text content, put in the job folder (source only, no binaries)

public.description: true lets any machine on the network run it, including ones that joined self-serve; leave false for work you would not show a stranger

result_path.description: file the job writes its answer to, default result.json; it comes back as output

timeout_s.description: seconds, default 120; the cap depends on your account's level (compute_backends)

name: compute_quote
title: Price of a compute job
